content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required prior authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table, whereas resubmission would not resolve the authorization issue. The deductible does not establish patient liability for this denial, so appealing is the appropriate next action rather than billing the patient or escalating.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
